chunks: These are the parables We put forward for mankind, but only those who possess knowledge understand them.
ai.seo_question: Who truly understands the parables of the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes a hierarchy of understanding where 'alim (the knowledgeable) grasp the deeper, often esoteric, realities of the divine signs, distinguishing them from the general populace who may only perceive the literal form. It underscores the necessity of scholarly interpretation (ta'wil) to unlock the spiritual truths embedded in the parables of the Quran.
